verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Teller sends webhook events when conditions or changes are detected in user enrollments, which hints that broken links surface to the integrator. Nothing shows documented expired or revoked statuses, or a Teller Connect update or re-authentication mode that avoids re-linking. Missing for 10: documented disconnected/expired/revoked enrollment status values, a re-authentication update flow in Teller Connect that preserves the existing enrollment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of repair behavior.
